slides.title: 5 texts every service business should save
body: Put these in your phone's text shortcuts today.

slides.title: "Sorry I missed you!"
body: "Sorry I missed your call, I'm on a job! Text me what you need and your area, and I'll send a price today."

slides.title: Give a range
body: "Most homes your size run $X–$Y. Can I ask 3 quick questions to get you an exact price?"

slides.title: Offer a real time
body: "I still have Thursday morning open. Want me to put you down?"

slides.title: Ask everyone
body: "Thank you for having us today! An honest Google review really helps a small business like mine: [link]"

slides.title: Make it easy
body: "If a neighbor or friend needs help, send them my number. When they book, your next visit is $20 off as a thank-you."
